thread.title: Dow's earnings reporters providing a 92-point boost to futures' rally - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: Dow's earnings reporters providing a 92-point boost to futures' rally - MarketWatch
text:
Of the 30 Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -0.35% components, 29 are trading higher in the premarket, with the three that reported third-quarter earnings accounting for nearly a half of the gains in Dow futures YMZ8, +0.92% Of the other reporters, shares of UnitedHealth Group Inc. UNH, +0.25% climbed 3.2%, Goldman Sachs Group Inc. GS, +0.63% rose 2.2% and Johnson & Johnson JNJ, +0.06% gained 0.4%. The stocks' price gains are adding about a combined 92 points to the Dow's price, and futures are up 227 points. The most active Dow stock was Apple Inc.'s AAPL, -2.14% which rose 0.9%. The lone Dow decliner Coca-Cola Co.'s stock CVX, -0.70% which lost 0.6%.
